interactiveDefault: Equilibrium remains the default unless the complete promotion guards pass. The experimental component uses the same production thermal balances through a structural option.

wallMesh.basis: Numerical grading chosen before measured-response scoring to resolve the inner thermal layer; no mesh or correlation multiplier is fitted to the pressure curve.
wallMesh.failurePolicy: Report an unresolved wall-mesh difference as a failed numerical check; do not select a mesh by its measured pressure error or loosen the limits after scoring.

initialization.liquidTemperature: IF97 saturation temperature at initialPressurePa, identical to v0.10 initial pressurizer temperature
initialization.wallTemperature: Uniform and equal to the initial saturation temperature; unmeasured generic initial-wall assumption
initialization.nitrogenInventory: Zero, constructed from initial total pressure minus the corresponding saturation pressure; no invented plant nitrogen measurement
initialization.volumesAndOtherInitialConditions: Exactly the v0.10 initial-boundaries.json ledger and generic volumes/capacity; no pressure-response fit

sourceAnalogue.heightBasis: Six published heat-structure axial lengths 0.7+1.464+3+3+3+0.7 m
sourceAnalogue.materialBasis: Composition 5: k=46.05 W/(m K), volumetric heat capacity=3.8775e6 J/(m3 K). No separate density, specific heat or alloy certification inferred.
sourceAnalogue.geometryTransformation: Preserve the existing assumed Krško pressurizer volume and use the analogue height to derive an equivalent cylindrical radius sqrt(volume/(pi*height)). This changes the analogue radius; end heads and detailed construction are omitted.
sourceAnalogue.qualification: Published model parameters from another PWR, not measured Krško construction or thermophysical properties. This is an explicit generic analogue assumption, not an identified plant replica.

otherConstitutiveAssumptions.phaseRelaxation: 0.1 s retained from the pre-existing unfitted phase-relaxation model, not identified from this transient
otherConstitutiveAssumptions.bulkInterfaceConductance: Zero; insurge stratification and interfacial mixing are not resolved
otherConstitutiveAssumptions.filmCondensation: Unfitted classical Nusselt mean gravity-film coefficient; noncondensable diffusion resistance, detailed spray condensation and entrainment are unresolved

interpretation: All cases preserve the same external forcing. No-wall isolates wall storage/condensation from separate phase inventories. Refined-wall assesses numerical mesh dependence, not a different physical model. Every case and every adverse channel change remains visible.
